edit.statement: The release of the Chinese startup DeepSeek's low-cost R1 AI model in January 2025 caused Nvidia's shares to fall about 17% on 27 January 2025, wiping out nearly $600 billion of market value, the largest one-day loss for any company in US stock market history.

edit.object: Nvidia's record one-day loss of nearly $600 billion in market value
